svg.title: Breakwater - a SOC and help desk training game you can play in the browser
svg.desc: A browser game that teaches real security analyst skills through a branching investigation. Hands-on SIEM, terminal, firewall, console, timeline, pivot and CVSS. Built in TypeScript, 160 tests, plays every ending.

g.text: A browser game that teaches real analyst skills through a branching
investigation. Hands-on tools, live cases, and five endings.

svg.text: Some cases are generated fresh each run
